name: Non-user disk survey
command:
for p in /System/Volumes/Data/Applications /System/Volumes/Data/Library /System/Volumes/Data/private /System/Volumes/Data/opt/homebrew /System/Volumes/Data/System/Library /System/Volumes/Data/usr/local '/System/Volumes/Data/macOS Install Data' /System/Volumes/Data/.Spotlight-V100 /System/Volumes/Data/.DocumentRevisions-V100 /System/Volumes/Data/.fseventsd /System/Volumes/Data/.TemporaryItems /System/Volumes/Data/.com.apple.templatemigration.boot-install /System/Volumes/Data/.PreviousSystemInformation /System/Volumes/Data/MobileSoftwareUpdate /System/Volumes/Data/cores /System/Volumes/Data/mnt /System/Volumes/Data/sw /System/Volumes/Data/home /System/Volumes/Data/Volumes; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; printf '
--- %s ---
' "$p"; du -x -k -d1 "$p" 2>&1 | sort -nr; done; printf '
--- other-account top-levels ---
'; du -x -k -d1 /Users/azhar.izzannada /Users/Shared 2>&1 | sort -nr; printf '
--- Applications top-level ---
'; du -x -k -d1 /Applications 2>&1 | sort -nr; printf '
--- VM files ---
'; stat -f '%z bytes %N' /System/Volumes/Data/private/var/vm/* 2>&1
